# Profit Monitr

> Profit Monitr is a $39.99/month service for restaurants, bars and venues. It sets a venue up with native reservations and ticketing, gives every influencer, promoter and campaign its own tracked link and promo code, traces clicks → bookings → guests at the door → revenue, and sends a plain-language brief every Monday: what happened, why, what made money, and the three moves worth making next.

Main message: Don't just track likes. Track what drives sales and reservations.

## What it does

- **Click-to-door attribution**: a unique link and promo code for each influencer, promoter and campaign, credited all the way to the guest checking in at the door.
- **Reservations and ticketing**: native to the venue's account and set up for them — their availability, prices and guest data.
- **The weekly brief**: one page every Monday built from the venue's own data, with three recommended actions ranked by what they are worth. Approving an action schedules it; its result appears in the following Monday's brief.
- **AI agents for the venue's website**: a search agent, a website agent and a reservations agent keep the site fast and findable by Google and AI assistants. Nothing changes on the site without the owner's approval.
- **Expert guidance**: a strategist session is included in the plan.

## Pricing

- One plan: $39.99 per month, everything included. No tiers, no add-ons, cancel anytime.

## Who it is for

- Owners and managers of restaurants, bars & lounges, nightclubs and event venues who promote through Instagram, TikTok, email, Google, paid social, influencers and promoters, and want to know which of them actually fills the room.
